source: FEATURE-20261119-listening-post-sub1 (D14352, D14369). 340520 Listening Post = clone of the Scanner Array 16216 without a group change (group 709 Scanner Array, category 23, anchorable; SDE 3396210 typeDogma: hp 10000, shield 5000, armor 2000, signature 2000, effects 901/1022/1023 online/anchor, no weapon). dogma.attributes 9 (hp) 50000, 263 (shieldCapacity) 50000, 265 (armorHP) 100000 = 200000 HP. The Living New Eden mod anchors it by its sentry path (typeID range 340520-340539 reserved for K1/K7) and makes it a target of the faction battles only while its owner is online. iconID 24666 = res:/UI/Texture/Icons/d-scan.png (SDE icons; the Scanner Array row is not in the local SDE, H3); the client keeps the source look. 340521 blueprint = clone of Spatial Attunement Unit Blueprint 33196 (like the PI and drill blueprints, D693/D700) with group 447. Manufacturing: plain minerals 12000 Tritanium, 4000 Pyerite, 1500 Mexallon, 500 Isogen, Industry V, 6000 s; copying 14400 s, ME/TE 6300 s and max runs 10 = the Scanner Array Blueprint 2821 (SDE 3396210 blueprints.jsonl). Shop 100 million ISK. Client: re-run ApplyClientData.

overrides.name: Listening Post
overrides.description: Passive listening structure built from a Scanner Array. Launch it from your cargo, then Anchor it 5-30 km from a stargate, an NPC station or your corporation's Upwell structure (low-security and null-security space only). No control tower and no fuel. It has no weapon. While someone of the owner corporation is online, faction fleets may attack it. Destructible.
